description: Reads what a webinar earned: paid orders and the amount per currency, open orders, refunds — and which offer tier (product) sold how often and for how much. Read-only, changes nothing. Money comes from the host's own shop (WooCommerce or any other shop connected to the site), never from estimates. Use it when the host asks what the webinar earned, which package sold, or where the upsell from tier to tier breaks. Do not use it for per-person spending (that is wi_list_webinar_leads_registrants) and never add two currencies together — each line stays separate. Without a connected site the answer carries example numbers (sample: true) and the next step.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id. Leave it out to read all webinars.

name: wi_get_webinar_revenue_woocommerce
title: Read webinar revenue and which offer tier sold
